title: DualMap shared-inference refactor: 17/17 scenarios pass
summary: The tested merge commit (1a507a7e) of PR #333 was exercised by the Webots CI with the DualMap backend; all 17 scenarios passed (17/17). The change set reworks Scene's DualMap integration to share a single inference implementation (Torch/TensorRT) with ConceptGraphs, adds a pinned DualMap source preparation step and build-time patch, and extends model export/engine building for FastSAM and a separate Replica text encoder. No failures were observed; residual concerns are runtime warnings and non-reproducible cached provider checkouts noted in boot logs.
pr_changes: CI workflow installs opencv-python-headless and adds new Scene test files (perception_models, prepare_dualmap, prepare_models, build_engines, prepare_viewer, inference_config) plus two new perception_engines tests.

Scene README documents DualMap Lite using MobileSAM/MobileCLIP-S2, FP32 engine builds disabling TF32, Jetson DualMap support, shared inference patch, point-cloud subsampling, and Replica export options.

Dockerfile.dualmap now copies a prepared _build/dualmap source and dualmap-inference.patch instead of git-cloning, installs requirements/scene-perception-dualmap.txt, and sets SCENE_DUALMAP_ROOT/SCENE_DUALMAP_EXPORT_CLIP.
Dockerfile.jetson adds optional DualMap requirements install, SCENE_PERCEPTION_BACKEND arg/env, copies _build/dualmap, and derives export model names from inference_config.
Added dualmap-LICENSE (Apache-2.0) and dualmap-inference.patch (1117 lines) injecting shared inference and NumPy mapping arithmetic into DualMap.
Added requirements/scene-perception-dualmap.txt (supervision, open_clip_torch, faiss-cpu, networkx, scikit-learn, etc.).
inference_config.py adds model_profile, backend-aware model_defaults/model_config (DualMap model space), export_model_names, and relaxed TensorRT validation for dualmap.

perception_dualmap.py loads models via model_config, uses load_perception for Torch/TensorRT, verifies prepared source, releases engines on stop, and reworks Replica export encoder (Torch-free TensorRT path).
perception_engines.py bumps ENGINE_BUILD_VERSION to 3, adds auto letterbox, unletterbox_boxes, instance_masks, trt_model_names, FastSAM support, and configurable CLIP interpolation.

Added perception_models.py (load_perception, create_clip_model with reparameterization and local-weight transform reuse); perception_torch.py adds device override, FastSAM, and TF32-disabled CLIP encoding under a lock.
cg_export.py adds _serialize_objects; perception_concept_graphs.py delegates to load_perception; service.py adds uvicorn timeout_graceful_shutdown.

build.sh adds viewer asset prep, DualMap requirements, DualMap weight fetching, DualMap layer build before TensorRT, and compute,utility driver capabilities; start.sh/start_native.sh/prepare_native.py/prepare_docker.py updated for DualMap and viewer paths.

build_engines.py adds replica-text and fastsam specs, per-row embedding checks, TF32 disable, and optional-model gating; export_models.py adds export_text/export_replica/export_fastsam and annotate profile.
Added prepare_dualmap.py (pinned archive fetch, checksum verify, patch apply, verify) and prepare_viewer.sh; many new/updated tests across Scene.
test_result: Webots CI ran 17 scenarios (flow, builtin, cap) against the DualMap backend and all passed (RESULT: PASS — 17/17). Coverage included camera/lidar snapshots, map save, memory save/search/hybrid_search/promote, navigation navigate, speech, voiceprint list, explore start/status/cancel, chronos, executor builtins, and scene list_objects/goal_near. The object_navigation flow explored, listed a plant object, resolved an approach pose, and navigation returned SUCCEEDED. Scene logs show DualMapDetector running on cuda with the shared inference path.

suggested_fix: No fix required for this run. Follow up by investigating the repeated 'RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in divide' in the Scene DualMap logs and the non-reproducible cached provider checkouts flagged during boot.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene logs repeatedly emit 'RuntimeWarning: invalid value encountered in divide' during DualMap ticks; may indicate degenerate geometry/feature normalization.
Boot log warns several cached provider checkouts have uncommitted changes, so the run is not reproducible from branch alone.
DualMap TensorRT path is not exercised here (SCENE_CG_INFERENCE=torch); FastSAM disabled (fastsam=False) in this run.
Many objects are dropped as 'on-floor'/'overlapping'/'class_outlier' in DualMap ticks; object retention behavior worth monitoring.
Soma shutdown logs show atlas connection refused warnings during teardown (likely benign ordering).
